messages:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need a focused copy pass for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages ahead of the launch. Scope: website hero + subheads, launch posts, a short benchmark narrative, webinar hooks, and inbound lead routing. Who wants which piece? Link to base brief: https://tiny.redwood/launch-copy
scott: I can take hero + benchmark paragraph. Priorities: 1) headline variants 2) short proof bullets (latency/cost/SLA) 3) one clear CTA per mode (Demo / Try / Contact Sales). Prefer concise, engineering-friendly tone.
tom: I'll handle launch posts + webinar copy. Tentative social/post cadence looks like this:
```
Mon 9am — teaser (hosted angle)
Wed 11am — benchmark thread (dedicated perf)
Thu 2pm — webinar signup (private deployments)
Fri 10am — roundup + blog link
```
Can we pick webinar date? Prefer 2 weeks out.
elaine: Heads-up: Dedicated messaging must include SLA + reserved capacity language. Private needs HSM/KMS note and on-prem availability. Also add a tiny callout about model pinning and rollouts. Benchmark numbers are in the product doc: https://tiny.redwood/benchmarks-2026 — scott, use the 95th pct latency + $/token savings stat.
nora: For inbound routing: we want separate lead paths per mode so sales can prioritize. Suggested form fields: company size, use case, preferred deployment (hosted/dedicated/private), desired throughput. Add UTM tags on all posts. Can we have different demo CTA URLs to route correctly? @maria
marketing-bot: calendar: Webinar draft event created for 2026-05-12 10:00 PDT — please update if different. Reminder scheduled 1 week before and 1 day before. :calendar:
maria: Good. Quick ask — provide 3 CTA options (short) for A/B across pages and posts. Also need a single-line benchmark blurb we can use in social. Deadline: copy draft by EOD Wednesday.
scott: CTA options (short):
- "Try Redwood — hosted in minutes"
- "Reserve dedicated capacity"
- "Request a private deployment demo"
Benchmark blurb: "95th‑pct latency under 120ms and up to 3x token cost reduction vs baseline — see our tests."
tom: For webinar hooks: 1) "How to cut inference cost without sacrificing latency" 2) "Scaling inference: hosted, reserved, and private patterns". I'll write the landing copy + tweet thread. Plan split-test subject lines.
elaine: Copy signoff timeline: engineering to approve benchmark language by Tue EOD, security to skim Private copy by Wed noon. If that lands, product can sign off Wed afternoon.
nora: Sales will map the routing once we have final CTA URLs. I'll add two lead queues: fast-response (hosted trials) and enterprise routing (dedicated/private).
maria: Awesome — next steps: scott + tom deliver drafts by Wed EOD, elaine to confirm numbers Tue, nora to prep routing rules. Sync meeting Fri 9am PT to finalize launch post schedule. Thanks all :raised_hands:
